dls_lock_hash.note: whole-file hash of the Phase 1 immutable DLS lock snapshot, computed for this document's traceability only; the lock's own internal per-source-file hashes live in that file's source_code_files field

dominant_failure_mode.name: stagnation
dominant_failure_mode.conclusion: Stagnation (a descent/basin failure inside the 5-step stagnation window) dominates over max_iterations, joint_limit_failure, and non_finite_* at every level examined (point-IK groups, trajectory waypoints, published frozen aggregate). A deeper iteration budget alone does not fix it.

waypoint0_findings.correlation_with_downstream_failure_stre: trials whose waypoint 0 fails show much longer mean maximum_failure_streak later in the same trajectory than trials whose waypoint 0 succeeds (association, not proven causal)
waypoint0_findings.h1_vs_h2_reason: no initial-state joint-limit-margin or sigma_min field exists for trajectory waypoints in any permitted evaluation summary; no per-iteration trace was captured (record_history was never invoked for these runs)
waypoint0_findings.plot_bug_finding: not a plot/data bug (root cause independently proven in docs/srpdik/DLS_TRAJECTORY_PLOT_DIAGNOSIS.md and reconfirmed at full-dataset scale this phase); a separate, minor, purely cosmetic issue exists in visualization/plot_target_actual_3d.py (no visual break at failed waypoints)

joint_limit_and_singularity_findings.candidate_structural_note: cand_D_pure_dls has joint_limit_avoidance=false, null_space_gain=0.0 (null-space centering off by design/selection)

training_strata.name: balanced_regular
training_strata.note: sampled independently from the full population; not mutually exclusive with strata 1-7, see SRPDIK_TRAINING_STRATA_SPEC.md section 2

unknowns: UNKNOWN_H1_VS_H2: whether waypoint-0 stagnation is caused by q_initial already at/near a joint limit versus the DLS iteration walking to a limit and stalling
whether the sigma_min/margin associations with stagnation are causal or confounded with general target difficulty (no controlled ablation run)

whether joint_limit_avoidance=false/null_space_gain=0.0 is a causal contributor to the high margin-zero rate versus incidental to candidate D specifically
